data.title: Login Velocity Anomaly
data.description: Detects abnormal login attempt velocity from a single source IP or subnet, indicative of automated credential stuffing tools. Legitimate users produce low single-digit login attempts per minute; credential stuffing tools generate dozens to hundreds, often targeting the authentication API directly rather than the web login form.

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Login Velocity Anomaly")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection and not filter_internal | count() by source_ip > 50")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:auth_logs event_type="login_attempt" (source_ip="10.0.0.0/8" OR source_ip="172.16.0.0/12" OR source_ip="192.168.0.0/16")
| stats count as event_count by source_ip
| where event_count > 50

falsepositives: Load testing or penetration testing activities against authentication endpoints
Misconfigured monitoring scripts with aggressive polling intervals
